### Houlihan Lokey Expands Power, Utilities, and Renewables Group With Experienced Hire


November 03, 2026


**Greg Han Joins as Managing Director in New York**


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Greg Han has joined as a Managing Director in its Power, Utilities, and Renewables Group. Based in New York, Mr. Han will focus on advising corporate and financial sponsor clients across the power and utilities sectors, including conventional power generation and renewable energy.


Mr. Han brings more than 20 years of investment banking experience to the firm. Most recently, he served as a Managing Director at Rothschild & Co., where he led the firm’s North American power, utilities, and renewables advisory practice, growing its presence in one of the firm’s core global infrastructure verticals. Previously, Mr. Han was a Managing Director at Evercore.


“As financial sponsors and corporate IPPs and utilities navigate an increasingly complex landscape defined by unprecedented load growth, a dynamic regulatory environment, and record-breaking capital formation, Greg’s deep sector knowledge and execution expertise will be invaluable to our clients,” said Xander Hector, Managing Director and Head of the Power, Utilities, and Renewables Group. “His exceptional track record advising both financial sponsors and corporations makes him the perfect addition to our market-leading team as we continue to expand our capabilities.”


“Houlihan Lokey has built an exceptional advisory platform in the energy sector, combining deep industry expertise with a highly collaborative and client-focused approach,” added Mr. Han. “The power and utilities sectors are undergoing a period of profound transformation, creating significant strategic and capital deployment opportunities. I am thrilled to partner with this talented group to help our clients navigate this evolving landscape and pursue their strategic objectives.”


The Power, Utilities, and Renewables Group operates within Houlihan Lokey’s Energy Group, which has earned a reputation for providing superior service and achieving outstanding results in M&A and A&D advisory, capital raising, restructuring, and financial and board advisory services. The team covers the entire energy spectrum through a dedicated, subsector-specific model, with experienced senior-level finance professionals assigned to each sector coverage area.


**About Houlihan Lokey**


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
